# Governance

Maintainers own project direction, repository access, releases, and enforcement
of community standards. Changes to durable repository policy require
maintainer review and must update the GitHub-facing contract they affect.

`source` is contributor-authored. `canary`, `beta`, and `stable` are automation-owned.
`CODEOWNERS` defines the default review routing for this project and must be
reviewed when a project adopts it.
